g.title: j959811853
g.text: Robots.

g.title: j1245805725
g.text: So... Quincy's playing a prank on you, and I'm the decoy.

g.title: j271910751
g.text: ROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTSROBOTS

g.title: j3258404584
g.text: huh?!?!? a prank? like... what kind of prank....?

g.title: j1096537348
g.text: ::cough:: i mean.... yeessssss??? what about these robots of which you speeeak?

g.title: j2909315720
g.text: He's filling your room with packing peanuts.

g.title: j2421351165
g.text: Honestly? I think it's how he shows he cares.

g.title: j2764449565
g.text: Have I told you about the giant spider robots on Venus?

g.title: j4018863443
g.text: So, have I told you about the robot hounds?

g.title: j3642247686
g.text: d'awwwwwwuhhh!! nobody's ever cared enough to fill my room with packing peanuts before!!!

g.title: j898171210
g.text: ... d'aaaaawwwww... that's so sweeet!!! nobody's ever liked me enough to play a prank on me before!!!

g.title: j3884130199
g.text: I THINK I SAW THAT MOVIE ONCE

g.title: j780605399
g.text: you. have. ROBOT. DOGS?!

g.title: j3072105074
g.text: welllll i won't let on that you told me what he was doing, i'll just sit here and pretend i'm super busy coding my game lol

g.title: j1444273653
g.text: but it wasn't a scifi movie it was a western. and okay it was pretty crappy overall but honestly i kind of liked it?

g.title: j2791554084
g.text: i suddenly realize i have a new mission in life. i need to own a robot dog. i need to name it fido. or scrap. or chip. CHIP!! CHIP IS THE BEST NAME FOR A ROBOTIC DOG

g.title: j656903606
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4169948923
g.text: i mean, it knew what it was trying to *be.* it didn't take itself too seriously, y'know? like nothing sticks in my craw more than a movie about cowboys that has a giant steampunk spider in it that tries to pass itself off as high art lolol

g.title: j1631925962
g.text: AND I WILL FRIGGIN' FIGHT YOU IF YOU SAY OTHERWISE

g.title: j1192489387
g.text: heheeeeee but i hope he realizes, of course... that. THIIIS! means... WAAAAR!!!

g.title: j289929994
g.text: not that this movie did mind you that's exactly what i'm saying. this movie didn't. but it totally had a giant robotic spider. although i'm sure the ones you're talking about are waaaaaaay higher tech

g.title: j2930633064
g.text: get it "chip" lol robot dog it's because computers have chips in them, like... a computer chip, get it? ... do computers in your era even have chips anymore?
